issues.jp_before: 母[はは]{は|wa-topic}ゆっくり横断歩道[おうだんほどう]{を|o-path}渡[わた]りました。
issues.problem: Distractor で is acceptable: 横断歩道で渡る (cross at the crosswalk) is natural and fits the English; English 'crossed the crosswalk' also slightly unidiomatic.
issues.action: Replaced distractor で with と; English changed to 'My mother walked slowly across the crosswalk.'

issues.action: Replaced distractor で with が.

issues.action: Replaced distractor で with が.
